items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: I remember Pepper and I, we saw our parents playing on stage

ctx.x: He would be asleep, and I would be asleep, and she wouldn’t. See we’d be on the train and she’d wake him up and so he says, “tell your father to go get it for you, Georgia,” he says, “I don’t want to.”

[inaudible] But I remember Sweets’ daughter, not Sweets, it was Snooky. He had three kids there was Pepper, Judy and there was another, we had a difference in age. And a lot of us, the parents would pack the lunches, and I remember we would wait, it was like after when they’d all settle down, we would go in and pull these boxes down and Pepper, Snooky’s son, would pull down the cake and the cake was all over him and then we would get in trouble. You know we were always, there were so many of us I can remember…
